node.title: Pair rank above shared-carrier rank confines bad joint anchors
node.statement: For W subset V x V with dim V=s<r=dim W<=2s and V subset F[X]_<K, bad joint-evaluation functionals span dimension<=2s-r, so all bad coordinates, including common zeros, number<=K+s-r. For A>K+s-r, a good-section cap L gives joint-list cap (n-K-s+r)L/(A-K-s+r). Every good section has pair dimension r-2 and shared carrier V_x of dimension s-1. A rank-s function-field-rank-one pencil in V x V must have constant direction. Arbitrary fields and fixed original domains; pair-to-slope accounting is not supplied.
